from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(description="The official title of the court document")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The broad category of the case (e.g., Administrative, Civil, Criminal)")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action (案由) stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
